# MALO-AVALIITE WEAPONS CORPORATION
\n
An unusual corporation from beyond the Colossus radius. [bold][color=orange]The Malo-Avaliite Weapons Corporation[/bold][/color] is an arms manufacturing company that sells unique guns and firepower to its customers. A somewhat mysterious corporation, their inhabitants supposedly hail from a moving city which keeps itself hidden through secretive means, their planetary cradle destroyed in an unspoken cataclysm.
Being a rather distant corporation they have had many major differences in their development compared to factions that grew up here. For one, their operations are all almost entirely orbital, relying on ships that instead house enough equipment to be completely self sustaining (ex. MAWC's Aurora cruiser.) and on the salvage in the area to continue functioning.
[bold]They are partially detached from normal resource development and instead rely on salvaging wreckages that they stumble across to gain resources.[/bold]
Malo-Avaliite employees are restricted in species to solely lizards and hydrakin, whom share equal levels of authority in the corporation, only differing in rank and established title.
Other species are considered [italic]"Less useful"[/italic] and thus see limited employement with minimal attention. [bold]This does not mean that the corporate's employees are inherently speciest however.[/bold] It only means that if you were to be employed as a non-lizard or hydrakin, you would only be treated like a grunt until you were to go through the [bold]promotion ceremony.[/bold]
Rumors hang of the company supposedly dabbling in biotechnology research and experimentation. Attempts have been made before to dig further into what these are, but the corporation has so far thwarted every attempt until now.
\n
## As a MAWC member, your goals are to...
\n
[bold][color=red] >SALVAGE ANY AND ALL POSSIBLE DEBRIS FROM ABANDONED SHIP HULLS. TAKE SHIP-HUNTING CONTRACTS TO MAKE MORE IF YOU NEED TO. [/bold][/color]
[bold][color=red] >MAINTAIN AURORA, MANUFACTURE AND SELL ANY FIREARMS YOU CAN OBTAIN TO THE SECTOR INHABITANTS. [/bold][/color]
[bold][color=red] >WATCH AERUMNA.[/bold][/color]
